changes: Vendored WASM, wrapper, graph and groups unchanged. Default LIF parameters and no plasticity. Original LC11/near profile has no silencing. Remote olfactory profile applies the pinned ningen tame783.json list of 161 silenced neurons; no learned weights.

remoteAdapter.input: ningen odMeat: ORN_DP1m, ORN_DC4, ORN_VL2a, ORN_VM7d, ORN_VM7v, per side; 0..48 Hz per neuron
remoteAdapter.outputs: DNa02 L/R steering; goL/goR mean of DNa03,DNa13,DNa15,DNa16,DNp32 per side; DNp09/MDN preserved; MN9 unchanged
remoteAdapter.sensoryChanges: world length units: signal reach 6, sensor offset +/-0.6; source contrast 6 -> 12; rate 14*log1p(5*concentration) retained
remoteAdapter.motorChanges: forward max(DNp09,goL,goR)/12; remote yaw (DNa02L-DNa02R)/10 clamped +/-1 then *1.1; LC11 yaw divisor remains 50
remoteAdapter.excluded: No source target-coordinate seek, hunger, plasticity or pretrained weights copied.
